title: Ribonav NC Rep1
extract_protocol_ch1: DRG were removed and processed to immunoprecipitate HA-tagged ribosomes, followed by RNA isolation using Pico pure RNA isolation kit | RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols
data_processing: Library strategy: RiboTag-Seq | Adapters were trimmed from reads using cutadapt version 1.13 | Trimmed reads were aligned using STAR version 020201 | Gene counting was performed using htseq-count version 0.6.1p1 | Differential expression was performed using DESeq2 | Assembly: mm10 | Supplementary files format and content: raw counts
